description: Java utility class for mapping between Note entity and API DTOs (Data Transfer Objects), providing methods to convert NoteRequest to Note entity, update Note entity from NoteRequest, and convert Note to NoteResponse.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: Utility class for mapping between Note entity and API DTOs.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a NoteRequest DTO to a Note entity.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates an existing Note entity with data from a NoteRequest DTO.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Note entity to a NoteResponse DTO.
